visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A white pot sits on a stove with water boiling vigorously, creating many white bubbles and steam. (2) A person's hand pours hot water from a white pitcher into a floral-patterned bowl containing white sweet potato starch. (3) The hand uses a white spoon to stir the starch and water rapidly in a circular motion until the mixture thickens. (4) More hot water is poured in, and the stirring continues until a sticky, clumpy dough forms. (5) The dough is transferred to a black surface covered in white flour, where it is pressed and flattened by hand into a thick, uneven sheet. (6) A large knife is used to cut the flattened dough into small, rectangular cubes. (7) The cubes are tossed in more white flour to keep them separate, showing the hands manipulating the sticky pieces. (8) The flour-coated cubes are placed into a pot of boiling water and cooked until they turn translucent and jelly-like. (9) They are scooped out and immediately submerged in a bowl of cold water to maintain their chewy texture. (10) Dry green beans are shown in a metal pot being rinsed with water. (11) The beans are cooked in a pressure cooker until they are soft but remain whole. (12) Yellow granulated sugar is poured over the cooked beans, and a spoon is used to stir them gently. (13) Large ice cubes are added to the sweetened green beans in a glass container, followed by the translucent cooked powder corners. (14) The final dessert, a mixture of green beans and chewy corners in cold soup, is stirred and presented on a spoon.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Slogan]: 粉角做法. [Slogan]: 燒滾水. (2) [Slogan]: 倒入地瓜粉中. (3) [Slogan]: 快速攪拌. (4) [Slogan]: 水不夠可以再加一點. (5) [Slogan]: 攪拌成團後. (6) [Slogan]: 倒出來. [Slogan]: 砧板可以抹點太白粉防止粘粘. (7) [Slogan]: 用手壓扁. (8) [Slogan]: 切小塊 (也可以用手刷). (9) [Slogan]: 撒點太白粉. (10) [Slogan]: 每塊撥開. (11) [Slogan]: 用滾水煮. (12) [Slogan]: 煮到粉粒不見. (13) [Slogan]: 起鍋立刻泡到冷水. (14) [Slogan]: 這樣粉角才會軟Q軟Q. (15) [Slogan]: 綠豆1:1.2的水. (16) [Slogan]: 用壓力鍋蒸熟 (電鍋蒸爐都行). (17) [Slogan]: 蒸熟後倒入砂糖 (這個做法是蜜綠豆). (18) [Slogan]: 攪拌均勻 (糖進去綠豆裡面). (19) [Slogan]: 放置10分鐘 (吃起來連綠豆都甜). (20) [Slogan]: 蒸的綠豆是整粒完整 (不會只有湯甜). (21) [Slogan]: 吃起來內軟Q. (22) [Slogan]: 想吃冰可以直接加冰塊. (23) [Slogan]: 加水放冰箱也可. (24) [Slogan]: 加入粉角. (25) [Slogan]: 粉角富翁. (26) [Slogan]: 要加多少都可以. (27) [Slogan]: 綠豆湯+粉角. [Slogan]: 絕配. (28) [Slogan]: 快收藏起來我阿嬤的配方.
